decisionPolicy.goRule: GO is valid only when every mandatory requirement has currentState verified, non-empty evidenceReferences, an accountable ownerRole, no unresolved blocker, no critical or high open incident, and signatures from the product, security, and operations approvers.
decisionPolicy.missingEvidenceRule: Absent, partial, stale, not-run, skipped, insufficient-data, or failed evidence is NO_GO.
decisionPolicy.changeRule: A material code, migration, configuration, dependency, signing, provider, data, contract, presentation, monitoring, or rollback change invalidates the affected evidence.
decisionPolicy.receiptRule: Historical receipts are immutable. Corrections append a new receipt and never rewrite prior evidence.
